evidence: Verified the induction S_t=applyTx*(S_c,T_(c,t]) requires a complete baseline, every subsequent committed transaction, correct decode, required order, and atomic/idempotent application.

Verified t_remaining=(H-b)/r only for positive r and labeled assumptions; it is a capacity estimate rather than a source-history guarantee.

evidence: Reviewed the baseline-stream induction and confirmed every step needs the next complete committed transaction in correct semantics/order; aborted, missing, partial, reordered, or misdecoded transactions invalidate the conclusion.
Reviewed the offset safety counterfactual: C behind durability creates replay, while C ahead of durability permits unrecoverable skipped source history after failure/cleanup.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed. References and local execution were checked on 2026-09-02. The finite model and documented examples do not establish any deployed engine or connector's log completeness, transaction ordering, image/schema fidelity, snapshot handoff, slot/offset durability, failover continuity, retention capacity, transport behavior, sink atomicity, security, privacy compliance, domain semantics, or reconciliation truth; those require source-specific contracts and production evidence.
